lines.A01: This is CosyMa Wave: mattress and motor in one.
lines.A02: The drive sits right inside the mattress – you don't need a new slatted frame.
lines.A04: … and the leg section adjusts too.
lines.A05: It carries up to 200 kilos and works on a slatted frame, a box spring or even on the floor.
lines.A06: You control it by remote or app – and it comes in 90 and 100 centimetre widths.
lines.A07: CosyMa Wave. Make more of your bed.
